_comment: Pre-crisis checklist items shown on each crisis page, grouped by crisisType. categoryId/itemId must exactly match frontend/src/features/crisis/crisisContent.ts group/item ids, because the frontend saves checklist tick state in localStorage keyed as `${categoryId}.${itemId}`. This file seeds the 'pre_crisis_checklist_items' Postgres table on startup (see services/crisis_content_service.py); /api/checklist serves from the DB and falls back to reading this file directly if no database is configured (e.g. local dev).

items.description: Complete this when your household has a written plan everyone can follow.
steps: Choose the conditions that will prompt you to leave early.
Write down where you will go and your main and alternative routes.
Give each household member a clear responsibility.

items.description: Complete this when everyone knows the destination and how to get there.
steps: Choose a suitable place in a lower-risk area.
Check that the destination will be available when you need it.
Share the address and travel plan with the household.

items.description: Complete this when essential supplies are together and easy to take.
steps: Pack water, a torch, batteries, first-aid items and a charged power bank.
Add essential medication and suitable food.
Store the kit somewhere everyone can reach quickly.

items.description: Complete this when essential copies are protected and easy to take.
steps: Collect identification, insurance details and prescriptions.
Place copies in a protective folder or waterproof bag.
Tell another household member where they are stored.

items.task: Plan support for children and dependants
items.description: Complete this when each dependant has a named person to help them leave.
steps: Write down who will help each person.
Pack medication, clothing and comfort items they may need.
Practise how you will leave together.

items.description: Complete this when pet transport and essential supplies are ready.
steps: Keep a carrier, cage or lead where it is easy to reach.
Pack pet food, water and medication.
Include your pets in the household leaving plan.

items.description: Complete this when essential health items and assistance are organised.
steps: List medication and equipment that must travel with you.
Arrange help for mobility, communication or other access needs.
Keep the plan with your emergency kit.

items.description: Complete this when contacts are available without internet access.
steps: Write down household, carer and support-service numbers.
Keep a paper copy with the emergency kit.
Make sure at least one other person has a copy.

items.description: Complete this when you know the safer places and routes near you.
steps: Check whether your home and usual routes are flood-prone.
Choose a safer place on higher ground.
Write down a route that avoids low-lying roads and crossings.

items.task: Write down your household contact plan
items.description: Complete this when everyone knows how to reconnect if separated.
steps: Choose one household contact and one contact outside the area.
Write down their phone numbers.
Agree where you will meet if phone services fail.

items.description: Complete this when essential supplies are together and easy to take.
steps: Pack water, a torch, batteries and a charged power bank.
Add medication, first-aid items and suitable food.
Store the kit above likely flood level.

items.task: Plan which items to move higher
items.description: Complete this when important belongings can be protected before water rises.
steps: Identify documents, medicines and valuables that must be moved.
Choose a higher storage place.
Prepare waterproof bags or containers where practical.

items.task: Plan support for children and dependants
items.description: Complete this when each dependant has a named person to help them.
steps: Write down who will help each person.
Pack medication, clothing and comfort items.
Explain the safer place in calm, simple language.

items.task: Prepare to move your pets safely
items.description: Complete this when pet transport and essential supplies are ready.
steps: Keep a carrier, cage or lead ready.
Pack pet food, water and medication.
Identify a safer destination that accepts pets.

items.description: Complete this when health items and assistance can move with you.
steps: Keep medication and prescriptions ready to take.
Arrange help for mobility, communication or other access needs.
Store important instructions in a waterproof bag.

items.description: Complete this when important numbers are available without internet.
steps: Write down VICSES 132 500 and household contacts.
Keep a paper copy with your emergency kit.
Remember that Triple Zero (000) is for life-threatening danger.

items.description: Complete this when your household can manage basic needs for at least three days.
steps: Set aside drinking water and non-perishable food.
Prepare safe lighting, batteries and a battery-powered radio if available.
Check the supplies regularly and replace expired items.

items.task: Put backup lighting somewhere easy to find
items.description: Complete this when safe lighting is ready before the power fails.
steps: Place torches or battery-operated lights in known locations.
Check that they work.
Store compatible spare batteries nearby.

items.task: Charge your phone and power bank
items.description: Complete this when the devices and correct cables are together.
steps: Fully charge the phone and power bank.
Check that the cable fits your phone.
Store them somewhere easy to reach.

items.task: Write down your energy distributor details
items.description: Complete this when you can report an outage without internet.
steps: Find the distributor name and faults number on your energy bill.
Write the details on paper.
Keep the paper with your household plan.

items.task: Prepare supplies for children and dependants
items.description: Complete this when essential care items are ready.
steps: Pack suitable food, clothing and comfort items.
Add required medication and care instructions.
Plan activities or support that do not require electricity.

items.description: Complete this when food, water and medication are available.
steps: Set aside enough pet food and water.
Check that required medication is available.
Keep a carrier, cage or lead accessible if you may need to leave.

items.task: Make a backup plan for powered medical equipment
items.description: Complete this when the equipment, backup time and contacts are written down.
steps: Write down each device and how long its battery lasts.
Ask the equipment provider what to do during a long outage.
Keep the provider and emergency contact numbers available offline.

items.task: Ask how to protect refrigerated medicine
items.description: Complete this after receiving advice for your specific medicine.
steps: Ask a pharmacist or healthcare professional how long the medicine can be unrefrigerated.
Write down the safe storage instructions.
Prepare an appropriate backup storage plan if advised.
